+# Host b721: tatsächlicher Flutter-Abschluss
+
+Der neue Job **132517423810** in [Run 43618076296](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-lernen/actions/runs/43618076296), Attempt 1, hat am 14. November 2026 um **17:04:52 UTC** den Status **completed / success** erreicht. Die Originalmetadaten und der tatsächliche Checkout binden ihn an Host `b7210db3f53361987fd33592de438fd7984d991a`.
+
+## Tatsächlich gemeldetes Ergebnis
+
+| Bereich | Aktueller Originalbefund | Originaljoblog |
+|---|---:|---|
+| Vollständige Flutter-Suite | **2.608 bestanden, 0 fehlgeschlagen, 0 übersprungen**; Exit 0 | Zeile 834 |
+| Runner-/Capturefehler | Keine in der Zusammenfassung | Zeile 834 |
+| Erzeugte Bilder | **546 PNGs laut Runner** | Zeile 834 |
+| Wallet-/Profilgruppe | 30 bestanden | Zeile 630 |
+| Quiz-UI-Gruppe | 46 bestanden | Zeile 744 |
+| Memory-UI-Gruppe | 36 bestanden | Zeile 800 |
+| Echter Dart-Englischproducer | 10 Fälle, 2.955 Prüfungen | Zeile 650 |
+| Quiz-Dart-Authority | 28 Fälle, 1.786 Prüfungen, 0 Fehler/Skips | Zeile 679 |
+
+Die drei gezielten Fluttergruppen überschneiden sich mit der vollständigen Suite. Ihre Zahlen werden **nicht zu 2.608 addiert**. Der Englischproducer prüft Aufgaben und Deskriptoren, keine Sprachinferenz.
+
+## Verbleibende Analysebefunde
+
+Der unveränderte Befehl `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings` meldet **214 Befunde: 209 info, fünf warning, null error**. Er ist aufgrund dieser bestehenden Konfiguration erfolgreich, aber nicht befundfrei. Sämtliche 214 Originalmeldungen mit Code, Quellpfad und Logzeile stehen in `analyzer-observations.json`. Die fünf Warnungen betreffen:
+
+- `_capturePhoto` unbenutzt: `lib/features/live/lumo_live_pro_screen.dart:343:16`.
+- Unbenutzter Import: `lib/features/magic_hub/lumo_magic_hub_screen.dart:16:8`.
+- `_ink` unbenutzt: `lib/features/story/widgets/lumo_story_scene.dart:150:16`.
+- Unbenutzter Import: `test/design/denkprofil_knobel_before_after_capture_test.dart:11:8`.
+- Unbenutzter Import: `test/iq/iq_extended_adventure_test.dart:5:8`.
+
+Außerdem meldet der Actions-Upload zwei Node-Deprecations (`punycode`, `url.parse()`); am Jobende folgt der Hinweis auf Node-20-Actions, die mit Node 24 ausgeführt werden. Diese Meldungen bleiben erhalten. Sie werden weder als neue Produktfehler noch ohne weiteren Beleg als harmlos eingestuft. Testnamen wie „Failed game write …“ bezeichnen bestandene Gegenfälle und sind keine fehlgeschlagenen Testergebnisse.
+
+## Quellen und Sicherung
+
+`original-flutter-job.log` enthält die vollständige einmalig abgerufene UTF-8-Jobausgabe: **120.661 Bytes**, 935 Zeilen, SHA256 `4192247ed86ddb17fa3a5d558eee665acbbb4f408fcc6e199ab8e9e1699bbab7`. `run-terminal-original.json` und `jobs-terminal-original.json` liefern den Terminalstatus; das Ergebnis folgt nicht allein aus PASS-Texten. Die spätere Prüfung `git diff --exit-code HEAD --` war erfolgreich.
+
+Der Actions-Upload und die originale Artefaktmetadatenliste stimmen für Artefakt **14123036723**, `lumo-nextgen-feature-flutter-evidence`, **343.154.361 Bytes**, SHA256 `f95c63dcc363d515c1268046289f9a3a012afdc66f79c9f27795e32f69f9223f` überein. Dieses ZIP wurde hier bewusst **nicht heruntergeladen**, nicht entpackt und nicht per CRC geprüft. Die 593 Dateien sind die Uploadmeldung; die 546 PNGs sind der Runnerbefund. Keine dieser neuen Bilder wurde für diesen Abschluss persönlich gesichtet.
+
+`full-flutter-summary-from-original-job.json` ist ausdrücklich aus der einen gedruckten JSON-Zeile extrahiert. Es wird nicht als aus dem Artefakt gelesene Datei ausgegeben. Der vollständige Maschinen-Eventstream bleibt im Artefakt; hier wird kein unabhängiger Event-Neuzähler behauptet.
+
+## Reichweite
+
+Dieser Abschluss belegt die aktuellen Flutter- und aufgeführten Dartprüfungen. Er prüft die neue Java/Kotlin-Sprachfunktion nicht; Hostkompilierung und strikte Speech-Verträge gehören zum getrennten Job. Er belegt keine gehörte englische Aussprache, echte Modellinferenz, Android-Wiedergabe, API35/37-Tour, Updateabnahme, physische 48-dp-Bedienung oder 60 FPS. Es wurden keine Produktquellen geändert, keine lokalen Fluttertests gestartet und kein Gitref oder Workflowlauf verändert.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Run the full Flutter suite including optional visual proofs; reject skips."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import signal
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+
+CAPTURE_DIRECTORIES = {
+    'LUMO_TUTORING_CAPTURE_DIR': 'tutoring',
+    'LUMO_RIG_STRESS': 'rig-stress',
+    'LUMO_CARDS_OPPONENT_CAPTURE': 'cards-opponents',
+    'LUMO_STREAM_E_CAPTURE': 'cards-memory',
+    'LUMO_NAVIGATION_CAPTURES': 'navigation',
+    'LUMO_GUIDED_CAPTURE_DIR': 'guided-learning',
+    'LUMO_VISUAL_CAPTURE_DIR': 'reasoning',
+    'LUMO_TOUR_DIR': 'tour',
+    'LUMO_FLUTTER_GAMES_CAPTURE': 'games',
+    'LUMO_LEARNING_CAPTURE_DIR': 'learning-adventure',
+    'LUMO_COMPANION_CAPTURE_DIR': 'companion',
+    'LUMO_SPATIAL_CAPTURES': 'reading',
+    'LUMO_CAPTURE_DIR': 'modernization',
+    'LUMO_CARD_FACE_EXPORT_DIR': 'card-face-exports',
+    'LUMO_NEXTGEN_READING_CAPTURES': 'nextgen-reading',
+    'LUMO_READING_CAPTURES': 'reading-passages',
+    'LUMO_ASSISTED_LEARNING_CAPTURES': 'assisted-learning',
+    'LUMO_NATIVE_PROFILE_CAPTURE_DIR': 'native-profiles',
+}
+CAPTURE_FILES = {'LUMO_CARDS_CUP_CAPTURE': 'cards-cup/trophy.png'}
+
+
+def summarize(events: list[dict], exit_code: int, errors: list[str]) -> dict:
+    names = {}
+    finished = {}
+    done = False
+    for event in events:
+        if event.get('type') == 'testStart':
+            test = event['test']
+            names[test['id']] = test['name']
+        elif event.get('type') == 'testDone':
+            finished[event['testID']] = event
+        elif event.get('type') == 'done':
+            done = event.get('success') is True
+    failed = [names.get(i, str(i)) for i, item in finished.items()
+              if item.get('result') != 'success']
+    skipped = [names.get(i, str(i)) for i, item in finished.items()
+               if item.get('skipped') is True]
+    passed = sum(item.get('result') == 'success' and not item.get('skipped')
+                 and not item.get('hidden') for item in finished.values())
+    return {
+        'status': 'PASS' if exit_code == 0 and done and passed > 0
+                  and not failed and not skipped and not errors else 'FAIL',
+        'passed': passed,
+        'failed': failed,
+        'skipped': skipped,
+        'capture_error_files': errors,
+        'flutter_exit_code': exit_code,
+        'runner_completed_successfully': done,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--flutter', default=shutil.which('flutter'))
+    parser.add_argument('tests', nargs='*', help='Optional focused files; default: every test')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if not args.flutter:
+        parser.error('Flutter executable is unavailable')
+    output = args.output.resolve()
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    env = dict(os.environ, CI='true', BOT='true', FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS='true',
+               LUMO_EXPORT_CARD_FACES='1', LUMO_TOUR_CAPTURE_SCALE='1')
+    for key, directory in CAPTURE_DIRECTORIES.items():
+        location = output / directory
+        location.mkdir()
+        env[key] = str(location)
+    for key, relative in CAPTURE_FILES.items():
+        location = output / relative
+        location.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        env[key] = str(location)
+    command = [args.flutter, 'test', '--no-pub', '--machine', '--concurrency=2',
+               '--timeout=60s', *args.tests]
+    events = []
+    completed = 0
+    watchdog_errors = []
+    with (output / 'flutter-machine.jsonl').open('w') as log:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(command, env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                                   stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, bufsize=1,
+                                   start_new_session=True)
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        last_output = [started]
+        stopped = threading.Event()
+
+        def monitor() -> None:
+            while not stopped.wait(5):
+                now = time.monotonic()
+                if now - last_output[0] < 180 and now - started < 2400:
+                    continue
+                watchdog_errors.append('Runner stalled for 180 seconds or exceeded 40 minutes')
+                try:
+                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+                    if not stopped.wait(5):
+                        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+                except ProcessLookupError:
+                    pass
+                return
+
+        watchdog = threading.Thread(target=monitor, daemon=True)
+        watchdog.start()
+        assert process.stdout is not None
+        for line in process.stdout:
+            last_output[0] = time.monotonic()
+            log.write(line)
+            log.flush()
+            try:
+                event = json.loads(line)
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                continue
+            if not isinstance(event, dict):
+                continue
+            events.append(event)
+            if event.get('type') == 'testDone' and not event.get('hidden'):
+                completed += 1
+                if completed % 100 == 0:
+                    print(f'Flutter acceptance: {completed} tests completed', flush=True)
+        exit_code = process.wait()
+        stopped.set()
+        watchdog.join(timeout=1)
+    errors = sorted(str(path.relative_to(output)) for path in output.rglob('*.error.txt'))
+    report = summarize(events, exit_code, errors)
+    report['runner_errors'] = watchdog_errors
+    if watchdog_errors:
+        report['status'] = 'FAIL'
+    report['scope'] = args.tests or ['complete Flutter suite; capture outputs recorded below']
+    report['capture_png_counts'] = {
+        key: {'directory': directory, 'pngs': sum(1 for _ in (output / directory).rglob('*.png'))}
+        for key, directory in CAPTURE_DIRECTORIES.items()
+    }
+    report['capture_file_outputs'] = {
+        key: {'path': relative, 'created': (output / relative).is_file()}
+        for key, relative in CAPTURE_FILES.items()
+    }
+    report['rendered_png_count'] = sum(1 for _ in output.rglob('*.png'))
+    (output / 'acceptance-summary.json').write_text(
+        json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
+    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+    return 0 if report['status'] == 'PASS' else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+name: LUMO Nextgen feature source acceptance
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-nextgen-feature-20261114]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-nextgen-feature-source-${{ github.ref_name }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+jobs:
+  flutter-contracts:
+    if: github.repository == 'Ullmann27/lumo-lernen' && github.ref_name == 'chatgpt/lumo-nextgen-feature-20261114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 55
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
+        with:
+          flutter-version: '3.44.9'
+          channel: stable
+          cache: true
+      - name: Capture exact source and install the existing capture font
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p feature-evidence .ci-results
+          git rev-parse HEAD > feature-evidence/HOST-SOURCE.txt
+          git rev-parse HEAD > .ci-results/source-sha.txt
+          flutter --version > feature-evidence/flutter-version.txt
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 update -qq
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 install -y fonts-noto-color-emoji
+          test -s /usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoColorEmoji.ttf
+      - name: Resolve locked Flutter dependencies
+        run: flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
+      - name: Analyze all Flutter sources
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings 2>&1 | tee feature-evidence/flutter-analyze.log
+      - name: Recheck durable wallet queues across caller zones and actual Memory profiles
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          flutter test --no-pub --reporter=expanded --timeout=60s --concurrency=2 \
+            test/reward_wallet_queue_zone_test.dart \
+            test/reward_wallet_transaction_test.dart \
+            test/games/memory_profile_storage_test.dart \
+            2>&1 | tee feature-evidence/wallet-zone-profile-regression.log
+      - name: Run actual Dart learning and table authorities
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          dart run tool/check_native_english_activity.dart --out feature-evidence/english-activity.json 2>&1 | tee feature-evidence/english-authority.log
+          dart run tools/android_qa/quiz_round_contract.dart 2>&1 | tee feature-evidence/quiz-authority.log
+      - name: Recheck the observed Quiz UI and reward failures
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          flutter test --no-pub --reporter=expanded --timeout=60s --concurrency=2 \
+            test/table_games_wallet_profile_test.dart \
+            test/quiz_native_roundtrip_lifecycle_test.dart \
+            test/quiz_play_extensions_test.dart \
+            test/quiz_category_lock_lifetime_test.dart \
+            test/quiz_show_live_ladder_lockin_test.dart \
+            test/quiz_premium_stage_layout_test.dart \
+            test/quiz_premium_stage_visual_capture_test.dart \
+            2>&1 | tee feature-evidence/quiz-observed-regressions.log
+      - name: Recheck actual Memory UI and unchanged profile/statistics behavior
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          flutter test --no-pub --reporter=expanded --timeout=60s --concurrency=2 \
+            test/games/memory_result_frame_test.dart \
+            test/games/game_round_regression_test.dart \
+            test/games/memory_native_entry_test.dart \
+            test/games/memory_screen_test.dart \
+            test/games/memory_theme_pack_test.dart \
+            test/games/memory_2027_stage_test.dart \
+            test/games/memory_match_feedback_test.dart \
+            test/games/memory_controls_hittest_test.dart \
+            test/games/memory_profile_storage_test.dart \
+            2>&1 | tee feature-evidence/memory-ui-regression.log
+      - name: Run the complete Flutter suite and every enabled capture
+        run: python3 scripts/run_full_flutter_acceptance.py --output feature-evidence/full-flutter
+      - name: Verify tracked source remains exact
+        run: git diff --exit-code HEAD --
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: lumo-nextgen-feature-flutter-evidence
+          path: |
+            feature-evidence/
+            .ci-results/quiz-premium-stage/
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30
+  android-host-compile:
+    if: github.repository == 'Ullmann27/lumo-lernen' && github.ref_name == 'chatgpt/lumo-nextgen-feature-20261114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with:
+          distribution: temurin
+          java-version: '17'
+      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
+        with:
+          flutter-version: '3.44.9'
+          channel: stable
+          cache: true
+      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@9fc6c4e9069bf8d3d10b2204b1fb8f6ef7065407
+        with:
+          packages: platform-tools
+      - name: Compile the actual Android classes including Memory and Quiz
+        run: bash scripts/compile_android_host.sh
+      - name: Verify local speech composition and cancellation with the compiled JVM toolchain
+        run: python3 -B scripts/run_speech_jvm_contracts.py --output host-compile-evidence/speech
+      - name: Exercise the private table transport using the compiled JVM toolchain
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p test_table_games_native_contract.py -v 2>&1 | tee host-compile-evidence/table-native-contracts.log
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: lumo-nextgen-feature-android-host-evidence
+          path: host-compile-evidence/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30
+
+  memory-source-contracts:
+    if: github.repository == 'Ullmann27/lumo-lernen' && github.ref_name == 'chatgpt/lumo-nextgen-feature-20261114'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
+        with:
+          flutter-version: '3.44.9'
+          channel: stable
+          cache: true
+      - name: Run real Quiz and Memory persistence, lifecycle and timing contracts
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p memory-feature-evidence
+          git rev-parse HEAD > memory-feature-evidence/HOST-SOURCE.txt
+          dart --version > memory-feature-evidence/dart-version.txt 2>&1
+          memory_exit=0
+          if ! dart tools/android_qa/memory_round_contract.dart 2>&1 | tee memory-feature-evidence/memory-round.log; then
+            memory_exit=1
+          fi
+          if ! dart tools/android_qa/memory_turn_scheduler_contract.dart 2>&1 | tee memory-feature-evidence/memory-scheduler.log; then
+            memory_exit=1
+          fi
+          if ! dart tools/android_qa/quiz_round_contract.dart 2>&1 | tee memory-feature-evidence/quiz-round.log; then
+            memory_exit=1
+          fi
+          exit "$memory_exit"
+      - name: Verify original dealer and all tracked sources remain exact
+        if: always()
+        run: git diff --exit-code HEAD --
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: lumo-nextgen-memory-source-evidence
+          path: memory-feature-evidence/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: LUMO Studio 2020 Android candidate
+on:
+  # PR synchronization is the single automatic APK event. A push to its head
+  # must not create a second build of the same source.
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-studio-20261113]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-studio-2020-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+jobs:
+  nextgen-authorities:
+    name: Nextgen ${{ matrix.activity }} actual authority
+    if: >-
+      github.repository == 'Ullmann27/lumo-lernen' &&
+      ((github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
+      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
+      github.head_ref == 'chatgpt/lumo-studio-2020-20261114') ||
+      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
+      github.ref_name == 'chatgpt/lumo-studio-2020-20261114'))
+    env:
+      LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        activity: [english, quiz, memory]
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          path: host-source
+      - name: Resolve the exact candidate Host and configured Native commits
+        id: sources
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_HOST: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python3 - <<'PY_SOURCES'
+          import json, os, re, subprocess
+          from pathlib import Path
